**Job Description**
 Frontgrade Technologies is seeking an Embedded Systems Software Engineer II to support the development of advanced mission processing systems for space and military applications. These rugged, high\-reliability systems integrate processing, I/O, power, storage, networking, FPGA, and other specialized modules.
   

  

 This hands\-on role spans embedded Linux, boot software, board support packages, device drivers, microcontroller firmware, FPGA logic, hardware interfaces, and application\-level software. The engineer applies a broad understanding of embedded\-software practices to moderately complex assignments under general direction.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, integrate, debug, and maintain embedded software for mission processing systems
* Develop and support embedded Linux platforms, bootloaders, board support packages, device drivers, and board bring\-up
* Develop microcontroller firmware for power control, sequencing, monitoring, communications, and board management
* Develop embedded applications, diagnostic utilities, manufacturing tools, and system test software
* Participate in requirements development, design and code reviews, verification, documentation, and controlled releases
* Collaborate with architects, system engineering and test engineering teams


**Experience**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* Minimum two (2\) years of related experience in embedded\-software or firmware\-development. OR (6\) years of experience may be considered in lieu of a Bachelors Degree. OR No experience required in lieu of Masters Degree.
* Working proficiency in C and C\+\+ for embedded or systems level development
* Knowledge of embedded Linux, BSPs, bootloaders, device drivers, kernel integration, or board bring\-up
* Ability to develop microcontroller firmware and interface with board\-level peripherals
* Knowledge of source control, build systems, testing, technical documentation, and multidisciplinary engineering practices


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Aerospace, defense, avionics, space, or other high\-reliability product development
* Development of FPGA logic using VHDL, Verilog, or System Verilog
* ARM, Power Architecture, or RISC\-V platforms; real\-time operating systems; and bare\-metal development
* AMD/Xilinx or Intel FPGA tools and embedded Linux environments such as Yocto, or Peta Linux
* Experience using JTAG debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers
* Experience supporting products through architecture, development, integration, qualification, production introduction, and sustaining engineering
